verses.text: Yahweh spoke to Moses, laying down the next word: 📣
‘Tell all Israel: live set apart, because I, Yahweh your God, am holy. 🕊️
‘Every one of you, show your mother and father respect, and keep my Sabbaths. I am Yahweh your God. 👪
‘Don’t go chasing idols or make yourselves metal gods. I am Yahweh your God. 🚫
‘When you bring Yahweh a peace offering, do it the right way so it’s accepted. 🕊️
Eat it on offering day or the next day. If any is still left on day three, burn it up. 🔥
If anybody eats it on day three, it’s detestable and the offering won’t be accepted. ⚠️
Whoever eats it carries the guilt for disrespecting Yahweh’s holy offering and must be cut off from their people. ⚖️
‘When harvest time comes, don’t clear every corner of your field or scoop up every last bit of the crop. 🌾
Don’t strip the vineyard clean or pick up every fallen grape. Leave some for poor people and foreigners living among you. I am Yahweh your God. 🍇
‘No stealing, no lying, and don’t run a con on each other. 🤝
‘Don’t swear by my name when it’s a lie; that drags your God’s name through it. I am Yahweh. 🗣️
‘Don’t take advantage of your neighbor or rob them. Don’t hold a worker’s pay overnight—get them paid by morning. 💵
‘Don’t curse someone who can’t hear you or put a trip hazard in front of someone who can’t see. Revere your God. I am Yahweh. 🦯
‘No crooked justice. Don’t give the poor special treatment or play favorites with the powerful; judge your neighbor fairly. ⚖️
‘Don’t spread rumors that drag your people or put your neighbor’s life in danger. I am Yahweh. 🗣️
‘Don’t let hate for your relative sit in your heart. Talk straight to your neighbor and correct them, so you don’t share their guilt. 💬
‘Don’t get revenge or keep a grudge against your own people. Love your neighbor like you love yourself. I am Yahweh. ❤️
‘Keep my rules. Don’t crossbreed different kinds of animals, mix two kinds of seed in your field, or wear clothes woven from two kinds of material. 🌱
‘If a man has sex with a female slave promised to another man, but she hasn’t been bought back or freed, there must be punishment—but not death, because she wasn’t free. ⚖️
He must bring Yahweh a ram as his guilt offering at the Meeting Tent entrance. 🐏
The priest will make atonement for him before Yahweh with that guilt-offering ram for the sin he committed, and he’ll be forgiven. 🙏
‘When you move into the land and plant fruit trees, leave their fruit alone for the first three years—don’t eat it. 🌳
In year four, all the fruit is set apart as a praise offering to Yahweh. 🍎
In year five, you can eat the fruit, and the trees will produce more for you. I am Yahweh your God. 🌳
‘Don’t eat meat while its blood is still in it. Stay away from divination and sorcery too. 🚫
‘Don’t shave off the hair at your temples or trim away the edges of your beard. 🧔
‘Don’t cut your bodies for the dead or tattoo marks onto yourselves. I am Yahweh. ⚠️
‘Don’t push your daughter into prostitution; that would dishonor her and fill the land with prostitution and wickedness. 🛑
‘Keep my Sabbaths and show respect for my sanctuary. I am Yahweh. 🕯️
‘Don’t go looking for mediums or spiritists; don’t make yourselves unclean by chasing them. I am Yahweh your God. 🚫
‘Stand up when an older person comes by; show elders respect. Revere your God. I am Yahweh. 👵
‘When a foreigner settles in your land, don’t treat them wrong. 🤝
Treat the foreigner living with you like someone born among you, and love them like yourself—you were foreigners in Egypt too. I am Yahweh your God. ❤️
‘No cheating in court or when you measure length, weight, or quantity. ⚖️
Use fair scales, proper weights, and honest measures for dry goods and liquids. I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of Egypt. ⚖️
‘Follow all my rules and instructions and actually live them out. I am Yahweh.’ ✅
